about: The First Question - QURAN: the shot list and story events, shared by the picture (engine/src/scenes/quran001/timeline.ts) and the sound (engine/tools/mix_quran001.py). A shot starts at its phrase's caption ('phrase': index into timing.json) or at a time in seconds ('at'); the video ends in the breath after 19:63 (timing.json guide.recitationEnd); the end card is an overlay that crossfades in over its last cardFadeSeconds. Events: seconds, or {phrase, plus} = that phrase's voice start + plus.

shots.why: neglected: city at night, walking with his phone glowing
prayer and pursued desires: busy at the desk
the warning: dark, cold light, slow push-in
except those who repent: before Fajr, the phone glowing on the nightstand
the dark courtyard before dawn: he walks to the mat
takbir: the warm light returns, the Fajr dot glows orange
not wronged at all: close, standing in prayer
His promise: low, through the arches
only peace: over the still pool
provision morning and afternoon: along the lanterns to him
that is Paradise: a slow push-in
those who were fearing of Allah: the crane up to the star mark; the end card crossfades in over the last 1.5 s (inside the length)
